st: Colorado: Extended Stay: There Goes the Neighborhood
d: Welcome to Limon Correctional Facility, a level 4 prison that houses many of Colorado's most dangerous inmates  while visiting Limon Correctional, the Lockup crew is greeted by angry inmates and the cell extraction team is called in to help.

t: Lockup Special Investigation: Lake County Juvenile Justice
d: For some kids, the revolving door of lockup seems to snag one generation after the next  17-year-old Kenneth and 14-year-old Kentrell have 10 brothers and sisters, a father in prison and a mother with a criminal record for public nuisance.

t: Lockup Special Investigation: Lake County Juvenile Justice
d: More than three thousand kids pass through the juvenile courts in Lake County, Indiana each year  here, consequences can range from a sleepless night in detention to the ultimate punishment for kids who keep coming back: Boys' School.

Three unforgettable inmates, each one about to cross the threshold to freedom  witness their joys, their fears, their triumphs and discover that sometimes the only thing tougher than being in prison, is staying out.
For some, prison might be hell, and it can be even worse for the sex offenders.
How gangs are managed in the jail system  how family relationships affect the jail experience.

st: Raw: A Young People's Guide to Jail
d: An exploration of first-time inmates that look like they should be sitting in classrooms rather than jail cells.
The troublemakers of the jail system and how correctional officers control the situation caused by these troublemakers.
